notes: Reason system (code 6). No antenna array, MIMO, or RIS appears anywhere in the paper. Earlier codes do not apply: a research letter that proposes and simulates a method (p. 1), FL over the air passes no_learning, the aggregation is analog over the air rather than digital (p. 3, p. 4: "analog communication is utilized in the uplink"), so the function is area 7.
